description: OLSIF — Rede & Operação / Observabilidade Ferroviária: dados origem–destino de cargas ferroviárias ANTT/SIADE 2025 — conjunto derivado e pipeline reprodutível OLSIF — Railway Network & Operations Observability: ANTT/SIAD is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Anderson da Silva Rosa (Universidade Federal do Pampa (UNIPAMPA), Campus Uruguaiana, Uruguaiana, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil). Conjunto de dados derivado e pipeline reprodutível construídos a partir do recurso ANTT/SIADE Produção Origem Destino 2025. O pacote contém 7.799 registros mensais com nove campos, transformação determinística de competência mensal e das medidas TU/TKU, validações de integridade, código de processamento e uma matriz agregada UF de origem × UF de destino (17×17) em toneladas ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
